mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0%, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a contraction in consumer demand that reduces corporate revenue expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), a simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0% and PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer confidence and economic expansion that drives corporate investment growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST increases, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0, it signals a manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate revenue growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in core inflation (CPIAUCSL) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signal persistent inflation requiring aggressive monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS increase, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-industrial production regime (INDPRO < 100.0), a simultaneous low GDP level (GDPC1 < 24000) and declining industrial output signals severe supply chain disruption that reduces corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0 and GDPC1 < 24000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
